[[Black Wolf|Black Wolves]] are [[charmable animal]]s that are native to the northern regions of [[Tyria]]. Black Wolves never relinquish prey while feeding, even if a pack member is attacked.

==Locations==
* [[Core]]
** [[The Battle Isles]]
*** {{NPC location|Zaishen Menagerie Grounds}} (levels 5, 12, 15, and 20, depending on unlock progress)
* [[Eye of the North]]
** [[Far Shiverpeaks]]
*** {{NPC location|Drakkar Lake}} (a single [[White Wolf|White]] ''or'' Black Wolf [[spawn]]s at the [[Shrine of the Wolf Spirit]])
*** {{NPC location|Varajar Fells}}
** [[Charr Homelands]]
*** {{NPC location|Grothmar Wardowns}} (east of [[Longeye's Ledge]] towards the bridge as per map, or south towards the next [[resurrection shrine]])
*** {{NPC location|Sacnoth Valley}} (in the central rocky regions, a possible spawn point being shown on the map)

==Missions==
*[[Bonus Mission Pack]]
**[[Ascalon]]
***{{NPC location|The Flight North}}

==Notes==
* In Drakkar Lake, if one of the wolves turn hostile, the entire pack will attack.
* Similar to [[White Moa]], Black Wolves in Grothmar Wardowns do not turn hostile upon activation of [[Charm Animal]] nor can they be attacked.
* Black Wolves deal [[slashing damage]].
* [[Zaishen Menagerie Grounds/Service costs|Unlocking cost]]: 1{{zsilver}} plus 100{{gold}} or 1,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Common, Tyria)''
